kurzbeschreibung:
**Wine & Dine in Innsbruck by Furtner’s**

Discover **Tirol’s** finest wines and hearty Alpine cuisine at **Furtner’s** in the heart of **Innsbruck**. Whether you’re craving a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a plate of melt-in-your-mouth **Kaiserschmarrn**, our rustic-chic setting promises an unforgettable dining experience.

Indulge in locally sourced ingredients—think **Tiroler Speck**, creamy **Käsekrainer**, and decadent **Apfelstrudel**—paired with our expertly curated wine list. From classic **Pinot Noir** to refreshing **Sauvignon Blanc**, every sip tells a story of **Tirol’s** vineyards.

After dinner, warm up with a **Glühwein** or a shot of **Obstler** by the cozy fireplace. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply savoring the flavors of **Tirol**, **Furtner’s** is your go-to spot for an authentic taste of the Alps.

**Reservierungen empfohlen** – book your table today! 🍷✨
